福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・安平區

豆菜芽仔井（延平街古井）The Bean Sprout Well

問大家一個問題：為什麼台南的蚵仔煎配的是豆芽菜？答案要從這口古井說起。這口井位於熱蘭遮城東南方、昔日鋪著石板的大員市街，也就是今天的延平街。當年它是安平珍貴的淡水來源，傳說水量豐沛、甘甜好喝。居民天天來取水，直到 1923 年安平有了自來水系統。但古井沒有退休！用井水孵的豆芽特別鮮美，供不應求。附近被叫做「豆菜寮」，古井也得了「豆菜芽仔井」的名號。安平是泥沙淤積的土地，種不了蔬菜，卻正好拿來孵豆芽。這就是為什麼直到今天，台南蚵仔煎裡的青菜是豆芽菜！二戰時自來水系統被戰火破壞，居民一度回頭喝井水。看井欄：那些凹痕是幾百年的井繩磨出來的。井底至今還看得到水。

Here's a question: why do oyster omelets in Tainan use bean sprouts? The answer begins with this old well. This well sits on the old stone-paved Tayouan Market Street, southeast of Fort Zeelandia. Today it's Yanping Street. In its day, it was a precious source of fresh water, said to be plentiful and sweet. Locals drew water from it every day until 1923, when Anping got its first public water system. But the well didn't retire! Bean sprouts grown with its water were famously delicious, and sold like hot cakes. The neighborhood came to be called the Bean Sprout Hut, and the well became the Bean Sprout Well. Anping is built on silt and sediment. It's no good for growing vegetables, but perfect for sprouting beans. That's why, to this day, the vegetable in a Tainan oyster omelet is bean sprouts! During World War Two, bombs broke the water system, and people came back to the old well for drinking water. Look at the well ring: the grooves were cut by centuries of well ropes. Water is still visible at the bottom.

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

豆菜芽仔井是安平延平街旁的一口古井。它曾是安平珍貴的淡水來源；有了自來水之後，居民改用井水孵豆芽，台南蚵仔煎裡的青菜之所以是豆芽菜，就要從這口井說起。

The Bean Sprout Well is an old well beside Yanping Street in Anping. It was once a precious source of fresh water. After tap water arrived, people used its water to grow bean sprouts, which is why Tainan's oyster omelets come with bean sprouts.

  1. 荷蘭時期起 From the Dutch era井位在熱蘭遮城東南方的大員市街，也就是今天的延平街。The well stands on the old Tayouan street southeast of Fort Zeelandia, today's Yanping Street.
  2. 1923安平有了自來水，居民不再天天來取水。Anping gets tap water, and daily trips to the well end.
  3. 之後 Later居民用井水孵豆芽，附近因此叫「豆菜寮」。People grow bean sprouts with the well water, and the area becomes known for them.
  4. 二戰 World War II自來水被戰火破壞，居民一度回頭喝井水。When bombing damages the water system, people drink from the well again.

認識景點

About the place

井：地上挖的深洞，人們從裡面取水。 淡水：不鹹、可以喝的水。這口井的水很甘甜。 水桶：人們用繩子把水桶從井裡拉上來。 豆芽菜：豆子發出的嫩芽。用這口井的水孵得特別好。

well: A deep hole in the ground where people get water. fresh water: Water that is not salty, so you can drink it. This well's water was sweet. bucket: People pulled buckets up from the well with a rope. bean sprouts: Young sprouts from beans. They grew well with this well's water.

蚵仔煎：台南小吃，裡面的青菜是豆芽菜。 泥沙／沉積物：水流留下的泥沙。安平就建在這上面。 豆菜寮：古井附近一帶的老名字。 自來水系統：把水送到家家戶戶的管線。安平在 1923 年有了自來水。

oyster omelet: A Tainan snack. The vegetable in it is bean sprouts. silt / sediment: Sand and mud left by water. Anping is built on it. Bean Sprout Hut: The old nickname for the neighborhood around the well. public water system: Pipes that bring water to homes. Anping got one in 1923.

井欄：井口的石圈，幾百年的井繩在上面磨出凹痕。 石板街：昔日的大員市街鋪著石板，就是今天的延平街。 第二次世界大戰：炸彈炸壞水管，居民又回頭喝井水。 巷子：窄窄的街道。這條巷子只容得下兩擔豆芽。

well ring: The stone rim of the well. Ropes cut grooves into it over centuries. stone-paved street: The old Tayouan Market Street was paved with stone. Today it is Yanping Street. World War Two: Bombs broke the water pipes, so people drank well water again. lane: A narrow street. This lane is barely two baskets of bean sprouts wide.

實景照片

Photos on site

今天的古井 The well today

這就是豆菜芽仔井的石井欄。今天井口蓋著透明蓋子，外面再圍上不鏽鋼護欄，把古井安全地保護起來。以前，人們用這口井的水孵出特別鮮美的豆芽。

This is the stone well ring of the Bean Sprout Well. Today the well has a clear cover and a steel cage to keep it safe. Long ago, bean sprouts grown with its water were famously delicious.

「延平街」石柱 The Yanping Street stone

古井旁的石柱刻著「延平街」和「三級古蹟」。延平街就是昔日的大員市街，號稱「臺灣第一街」。窗上的牌子寫著「維護古蹟周圍，保持環境衛生」。

The stone pillar beside the well says Yanping Street and grade three historic site. Yanping Street was the old Tayouan Market Street, known as Taiwan's first street. The sign asks visitors to keep the area clean.
